town_description: Koderma (also spelled Kodarma) is the administrative headquarters of Koderma district in northern Jharkhand, on the northern end of the Chota Nagpur plateau. Once famous as the 'mica capital' of India, the district's mica industry declined and many units closed; the larger commercial city nearby is Jhumri Telaiya. Religious places in the district include the Dhajadhari Dham hilltop Shiva shrine, the Surajkund hot spring area and the Shaktipeeth of Maa Chanchala Devi.
